business_meaning: Surrogate key that uniquely identifies a dimension row for a savings account version.
inferred_rules: Surrogate key is unique and non-null; used as PK and FK in fact tables; generated by presentation ETL; increments or sequence-managed.

business_meaning: Unique savings account number from the source system.
inferred_rules: Non-null; length <= 20; natural/business key that may repeat across SCD2 versions; should be stable across versions for the same account.

business_meaning: Identifier of the customer who owns the savings account.
documented_rules: One customer can hold several accounts.
inferred_rules: Non-null; length <= 20; referential to customer/party entity; same CustomerID can appear on multiple accounts.

business_meaning: Code representing the savings product type.
documented_rules: Allowed values: EASY_ACCESS, FIXED_1Y, NOTICE_90, ISA.
inferred_rules: Value must be one of the allowed product codes; ProductCode drives other rules (e.g., FIXED_1Y -> AccountMaturityDate mandatory); non-null.

documented_rules: Allowed values: OPEN, CLOSED, DORMANT, FROZEN.
inferred_rules: Non-null; when AccountStatus = CLOSED then AccountCloseDate must be populated and Balance in facts should be 0.00; statuses may affect permitted transactions.
Non-null; ISO currency code length = 3; values other than GBP indicate data quality issue.
Non-null; must be <= current date (not in the future); if AccountMaturityDate populated then AccountOpenDate < AccountMaturityDate; AccountCloseDate, if populated, should be >= AccountOpenDate.

business_meaning: Maturity date for fixed-term savings products.
inferred_rules: If populated must be > AccountOpenDate; when ProductCode = FIXED_1Y then non-null; for non-fixed products typically null; should not be in the past relative to Product tenure at creation (where applicable).

business_meaning: Date the account was closed, when applicable.
inferred_rules: If populated must be >= AccountOpenDate and <= current date; when AccountStatus = CLOSED then non-null; when AccountStatus != CLOSED should be null.

business_meaning: SCD2 start timestamp indicating when this dimension version became effective.
documented_rules: Dim uses ValidFrom/ValidTo with 9999-12-31 indicating the current version.
inferred_rules: Non-null; ValidFrom <= ValidTo; ValidFrom is used as LoadDate mapping to facts; for current row ValidTo = 9999-12-31; SCD2 ranges for same natural key must not overlap.

business_meaning: SCD2 end timestamp indicating when this dimension version ceased to be effective.
documented_rules: Dim uses ValidFrom/ValidTo with 9999-12-31 indicating the current version.
inferred_rules: Non-null; ValidTo >= ValidFrom; current version uses ValidTo = 9999-12-31; SCD2 ranges for same natural key must be contiguous/non-overlapping.

business_meaning: Flag indicating whether the row is the current version of the account (1 = current).
inferred_rules: Exactly one row per natural account key should have IsCurrent = 1; IsCurrent = 1 implies ValidTo = 9999-12-31; IsCurrent is 0 for historical rows.
